heading: Here’s what happened today
body: We will be closing this live page soon. Here’s a quick recap of the main developments today:

heading: Global economy resilient to war shock but impact lingers, international agencies say
body: The global economy has been “broadly resilient” to the shock from the US-Israel war on Iran, but some effects of the conflict could linger, according to a joint statement from the International Energy Agency, International Monetary Fund, World Bank Group and World Trade Organization.

heading: Firefighter killed in attack on Iranshahr airport: IRNA
body: A firefighter has been killed after an attack on facilities at Iranshahr airport in southeastern Iran, according to Iranian state news agency IRNA.

heading: Oil prices edge higher as US strikes Iran
body: Oil prices have climbed as new US military action against Iran dampens expectations for a swift resolution to the conflict and the subsequent reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, according to the Reuters news agency.

heading: Ghalibaf warns US: ‘Strike, and you will be struck’
body: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has warned the US that “bullying and breaking promises are no longer without cost”.

heading: Air raid sirens sound again in Bahrain
body: Warning sirens are blaring in Bahrain for the second time this morning.
